Constructibility of the widened membership test against the shipped head, checked by reading the nine assets the head names (grep counts of localStorage or sessionStorage, and of documentElement): theme.js 4 and 2, nav-collapse.js 4 and 2, vendor/htmx.min.js 1 and 0, board-dnd.js 0 and 4, keyboard.js 0 and 5, form-errors.js 0 and 1, board-lane-dnd.js, board-live.js and csrf-upload.js 0 and 0. Only the two pre-paint assets name both, so a names-based membership test can refuse every member that defers and still accept the shipped head. the_head_this_repository_ships_is_accepted and the 1463-asset membership sweep are therefore satisfiable by one rule, with no contradiction between them, and all twenty-four shapes of the sweep are determinate under the same rule.

The oracle derives each expected verdict independently of the rule under test. The twenty-four-shape sweep computes it from the shape (names both means plain, otherwise defer) through the Verdictish enum, and the 1463-asset sweep computes membership from the segment kinds the asset was built from, never by calling paints_stored_state_onto_the_document. The sweep also asserts its own three witnesses are present in the enumeration (alias plus element reference, settled-DOM line plus a direct read, comment-only mention), so the law cannot lose its witnesses and stay green. Both domains are closed and small, so the enumeration is exhaustive rather than generated, which matches a crate that vendors no property-test library. The identity of the one refusal text for the input class the gate cannot split is asserted by byte-for-byte comparison between the aliased stamper and the settled-DOM asset naming the same pair, per attribute, and the forbidden over-claim wordings are asserted absent.
